Build a Simple Bioconductor Container

If you would like to create a new container with a set of packages and some data or scripts, and be able to easily share it with other users through docker hub or the Github container registry, this package might be useful.

This package was developed as part of the EuroBioc 2026 hackathon.

A citable BioHackrXiv preprint is also available (DOI:10.37044/osf.io/acxky_v1).
